acceptanceCriteria: The AHI-032 compaction-child test is deterministic: it polls for ESRCH with a bounded deadline or awaits the child's observed exit before asserting.
A child that truly survives past the bounded deadline still fails the test.
The test stays green across repeated runs under parallel load (record host, run count and load).
body:
Reported 2026-10-05 by the peer session "Claude-mem repository analysis" while working V1-0767 (branch claude/v1-0767-opencode-adapter-ledger at bf459f25, base fecce039). Suspected defect in the test, not confirmed as a product defect.

Reproduction: `GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=1 -timeout 30m -run 'Harness|SelfObservation|HostAdapter|AdapterDegradation|UseCaseReceipt' ./cmd/corvint/` under load failed once with `not ok 56` at integrations/host-adapters.test.mjs:812, `assert.throws(()=>process.kill(pid,0),/ESRCH/)` reporting "Missing expected exception": the killed compaction child was still signalable after session.deleted plus await pending, probably an unreaped zombie or an in-flight kill. The test passed 5 of 5 times in isolation (node --test --test-name-pattern) and the full TestHostAdapterJavaScriptHosts rerun passed. V1-0767 does not touch session-context or compaction code.

Expected: the test waits for or polls until the child exits before asserting ESRCH. Actual: an intermittent assertion failure under load.

Related but distinct: V1-0764 (Go TestPassiveWitnessSettle/AHI-032 settle deadline in internal/opencodequalification) and V1-0371 (product descendant cleanup when the leader closes).
title: tests: host-adapters AHI-032 "deleting a session cancels its active compaction child" asserts ESRCH before the killed child is reaped (suspected flake)
